entries.desc: Create a story from an approved draft in a temporary git repo; the command prints the story id plus worktree bootstrap/cd guidance, records worktree metadata, and leaves the main worktree with an empty git status.

evidence.note: Fresh smoke on HEAD a3f4493f creates an approved draft, runs story_create --fromDraft, sees worktree output, records story.worktree, and confirms the clean-main path leaves git status empty.

entries.desc: When fromDraft deletes draft metadata and writes active story metadata in the same bootstrap flow, those main-side metadata changes are closed by a generic transaction before the story branch/worktree is created.

evidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:worktree-authority-smoke
evidence.note: fromDraft now preflights a clean git index before any story/draft/worktree mutation, then commits only bounded active-story/source-draft metadata paths, verifies only those paths are clean, and merges current main into the new story branch.

entries.desc: If fromDraft bootstraps a worktree but leaves any tracked or untracked story/draft metadata residue in main, the verification must fail with a direct clean-main assertion instead of relying on manual cleanup.

evidence.note: Regression covers both dirty shapes: unrelated unstaged/untracked user edits remain dirty while bounded metadata closes cleanly, and unrelated staged edits are rejected before active story creation, draft deletion, or worktree registration.

entries.desc: The targeted worktree-authority smoke runs the fromDraft path and asserts three concrete outcomes: worktree exists, main git status is empty, and story/B-* contains main via merge-base ancestry.

evidence.note: Fresh smoke asserts worktree registration, empty main git status in the clean case, and merge-base ancestry from main to story/B-* after story_create --fromDraft.

entries.desc: The smoke covers the field shape where INIT_CHECK/worktree metadata exists but the bootstrap transaction would otherwise leave active story or draft metadata changes behind in the main checkout.

evidence.note: Regression covers committed draft metadata: story_create --fromDraft deletes the draft, writes active story metadata, commits that bounded transaction, and syncs it into the story branch.

entries.desc: If the fromDraft branch is created from a stale base that does not contain current main, or if main has dirty metadata after bootstrap, the smoke must fail before reporting success.

evidence.note: Smoke now fails if bounded metadata remains dirty, story/B-* misses current main, unrelated unstaged/untracked edits are consumed, or unrelated staged edits mutate story/draft/worktree before rejection.

entries.desc: Run the targeted worktree-authority smoke from the story worktree and record passing evidence tied to the fromDraft clean-main and branch-ancestry intents.

evidence.note: Targeted smoke passed on HEAD a3f4493f and now covers clean-main, dirty-main preservation, staged-index preflight rejection, bounded metadata cleanliness, and branch ancestry.

entries.desc: Run the affected package or Koala validation command set required for a worktree/gate orchestration change and record passing evidence through checklist_update.

evidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:init-check-bootstrap
evidence.note: TypeScript build passed and INIT_CHECK bootstrap regression still passes, showing ordinary branch isolation remains intact after the fromDraft staged-index and metadata sync fixes.

entries.desc: Evidence is recorded against the current story HEAD/material hash so koala validate does not accept stale smoke results after implementation or test changes.

evidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:worktree-authority-smoke && npm run test:init-check-bootstrap
evidence.note: Evidence was refreshed after commit a3f4493f, so Koala freshness checks see current code/test material including staged-index preflight coverage.

entries.desc: koala validate must block TEST/DONE if the targeted smoke is missing, failed, or stale, especially for the clean-main and story-branch-contains-main assertions.

evidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:worktree-authority-smoke && npm run test:init-check-bootstrap
evidence.note: The command set would fail if targeted smoke were missing, stale, failed, or unable to catch dirty story/draft metadata, stale story branch ancestry, or post-mutation staged-index rejection.
